facts.statement: The Community Team held dance parties in Sanctuary on Server 1 on October 21, 2011.
facts.quote: The parties will take place in Sanctuary on Server 1

facts.statement: Dance party time slots on October 21, 2011 were 9:30-10:30 a.m. PDT and 4:00-6:00 p.m. PDT.
facts.quote: Friday, October 21st from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 pm. PDT!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms Celebrates 20 Million Registered Players!
article_summaries.summary: SOE's official news post announcing 20 million registered players and a limited-time giveaway of a Letterman Jacket for logging in between October 21 and October 31, 2011. The Community Team also held two dance parties in Sanctuary on Server 1 on October 21, 2011. The post gives the launch date as April 28, 2009.
